cases.question: How long does a customer have to return a defective item?
cases.answer:
A customer has 90 days from the purchase date to return a defective item, regardless of the category (including electronics). 

Conditions:
- The customer must show the receipt or give the order number so you can confirm the purchase date.
- Offer a replacement first; if none is available, refund to the original payment method.
- No restocking fee applies.

Sources: POL-DMG-002

cases.question: Can I accept a return without a receipt?
cases.answer:
Yes, you can accept a return without a receipt under the following conditions:
- Offer store credit only, valued at the item's lowest selling price in the last 60 days.
- Ask for a government photo ID and record it on the return.
- No-receipt returns are capped at $150 per customer in any rolling 30-day period.
- Electronics cannot be returned without a receipt.
- Recalled items can be refunded in full at any time without a receipt.
- Even exchanges (the same item in a different size or colour) can be done without a receipt if the NovaMart tag is attached and the item is unused.

Sources: POL-RET-001, POL-DMG-002, POL-EXC-003

cases.question: I'm scheduled to work Black Friday and I've woken up sick. What do I need to do?
cases.answer:
During peak season (which includes Black Friday), you must give notice at least 4 hours before your shift starts AND make a phone call to the Manager on Duty; a message in the Staff app alone is not sufficient. A doctor's note is required from the 2nd consecutive day of absence.

cases.question: A customer wants to return opened headphones they bought 10 days ago with a staff discount. What do I do?
cases.answer:
Opened headphones can be returned within 14 days of the receipt date, so a return at 10 days is within the allowed window. The item must be complete and undamaged with all accessories. A 15% restocking fee is deducted from the refund unless the item is defective. Because the headphones were bought with the employee discount, the refund is the discounted price actually paid (not the full shelf price) returned to the original payment method.

Sources: POL-RET-001, POL-EMP-004

cases.question: A customer's order shows as DELAYED. What should I tell them?
cases.answer:
Apologise for the inconvenience and share the revised ETA (estimated delivery date) exactly as shown in the order system. Never promise a delivery date that is not in the order system. If the order is more than 5 business days past its original ETA, offer a refund of the shipping fee; Customer Care processes that refund. 

If you have the customer's order number, I can look up the specific details for you.

Sources: POL-ORD-005

results.title: Orders, Shipping & Delivery
results.text:
Orders, Shipping & Delivery > Order status meanings
- PROCESSING: paid and confirmed, not yet picked; can still be cancelled at the till or by Customer Care.
- PICKED: being packed in the warehouse; can no longer be cancelled.
- SHIPPED: handed to the carrier; a tracking number is available.
- OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: on the carrier's vehicle for delivery today.
- DELIVERED: the carrier has confirmed delivery.
- DELAYED: a carrier exception has occurred; the order system shows a revised ETA.
- CANCELLED: cancelled before shipping; any payment has been refunded.
- RETURNED: the item has come back to NovaMart and the refund has been issued.
